//: Licence allow-list (SEC §14). A package passes when its licence is in `allowed` (for 'A OR B', one of them; for 'A AND B', both), or when an exception names it with a reason. A trailing * in an exception matches platform variants of the same package; list every licence string the variants use (they differ between Windows and Linux).

exceptions.reason: CSS compiler that Next.js runs at build time. MPL-2.0 applies per file and only to changes to its own files; we use it unmodified and none of its code reaches users.

Image library binaries (libvips is LGPL-3.0) that Next.js uses for image optimisation on our own servers. Used unmodified as a separate library, and not shipped in the guard app. Windows bundles libvips into one package; Linux ships it separately as @img/sharp-libvips-*.
Browser-support data used by build tools to choose CSS and JavaScript targets. Data, not code; attribution is kept in the package.
